issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request from DSTU2 asking to replace the small target.png globe used for section links with an SVG or higher-resolution link icon; the Jira comments record svn revision 9868 as the application point.
initial_application: Git-svn commit beb596b9d50c407e8e28814061a0ea66ad155a6f, corresponding to svn revision 9868 and titled '#12143 - replace globe icon for link', added tools/html/assets/images/link.svg and changed the then-current publisher/WebMaker self-link generation from target.png to assets/images/link.svg.
additional_context: The old in-repository Java publisher sources were later removed or superseded by the current Gradle/kindling build. In the current checkout, target.png text references outside generated publish output are limited to the publish.ini image list, while the SVG link asset remains present. Current build.fhir.org pages render section self-links with inline SVG markup and contain no target.png references. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the implementer-facing current specification already uses SVG link icons for section self-links. The remaining target.png asset/listing is not a current semantic or rendering defect for this issue.
